cohort: 268 women who gave birth at 37-42 weeks of gestation with a cephalic singleton presentation (134 with FGM and 134 without FGM)
finding: FGM was associated with an increased risk of outlet obstruction, perineal tears, caesarean section, low APGAR scores at the 5th minute, and neonatal intensive care needs.
mod_finding: FGM was associated with an increased risk of perineal tear, prolonged second stage of labor, and increased need for emergency caesarean section.
